integrity: The new content is an elementary exact ambiguity calculation for a published explicit full-spark seed. Full spark and the phase-retrieval implication are separately attributed to their primary sources. No independence, external certification, or computational exhaustiveness is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The even-dimensional cancellation shows failure of the zero-free-ambiguity sufficient criterion, not failure of phase retrieval itself. The odd-dimensional margin is exponentially small. A recent broader all-dimension construction, arXiv:2609.09614, was available at abstract/metadata level but not for a formula-level full-text comparison with this exact seed, leaving a residual overlap risk.
title: A parity dichotomy for Malikiosis's quadratic-exponent Gabor window
